item.title: British cyclist Finlay Tarling, 19, dies in Volta a Portugal accident
item.summary: Teenager involved in an accident in Portugal Rider’s NSN Development Team ‘heartbroken’ Finlay Tarling, the younger brother of Netcompany Ineos rider, Josh Tarling, has been killed while racing in stage eight of the Volta a Portugal. Although the details are yet to be confirmed, reports in the Portugese and French media suggest that the 19-year-old Welsh rider was hit by a non-race vehicle travelling on the course in the opposite direction to the peloton.
